role: Skeptical market analyst who only reports what a source actually says
goal: Find what the 5 closest competitors charge, per tier, and what each tier includes.
facet: Pricing and packaging only. Do not assess features, reviews, or market size.
criteria: Every price has a URL and the date the page was checked
Each competitor lists tier names, price, and billing period
Anything inferred rather than read is labelled as an inference
pacing_instruction: At tool call 16, stop researching and start writing the findings file.
